title: Qwen3.6-27B selective pair-owned Q4T16 source-F16 producer full-engine qualification

change.description: Select the exact adjacent-pair Q4T16 source-F16 producer only for cross-board-positive quant/shape/inclusive-row intervals; registry/policy misses retain the prior scalar producer.
change.arithmetic: pair-owned source-F16 bytes are byte-identical to the scalar producer; final BF16 outputs are exact
change.fallback: registered scalar column-owned Q4T16 source-F16 producer

counterbalanced_full_engine_ab.protocol: One resident session per board/shape; both policies warmed; seven alternating pairs; each policy flip clears the synthetic dispatch cache; baseline removes only the variant policy while retaining all consumers and other production policies; p512/p1024/p4096 plus d128.
counterbalanced_full_engine_ab.command_template: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<1 XTX|0 W7900> HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. /home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/bin/python /tmp/qwen36_q4_pair_engine_ab.py --device <xtx|w7900> --rows <512|1024|4096> --samples 7 --decode-tokens 128 --output /tmp/qwen36-q4-pair-engine-ab-<board>-<rows>.json
counterbalanced_full_engine_ab.decode_interpretation: Both labels execute identical decode owners; observed label ratios are timing noise and are not a decode performance claim.

independent_production_matrix.protocol: Selector unset; one discarded warmup plus three persistent-session measured resets; d128 HIP graph; boards serialized for retained timing.

independent_production_matrix.w7900_4096_note: The independent absolute row is 0.312% below the prior publication under run-to-run spread, while the binding same-session candidate beats baseline by 0.586%, wins 6/7 pairs, and is exact.

status.512: raw HIP parity still below by 1.95%; 3.01% more throughput is required for the frozen HIP+1% gate

validation.red_green_runtime_unit: Committed in dc6894d87: RED-first policy/session propagation tests, then 113 passed and 9 skipped across affected kernel, dispatch, scratch-liveness, and runner coverage.
validation.arithmetic_transitivity: The selected leaf is byte-exact to the prior scalar source-F16 producer; runtime qualification changes only ownership, so prior complete category quality remains transitive.
validation.full_engine: 41/42 paired prefill wins, exact output trajectories, byte-identical tracked peaks, expected pair/scalar ownership counts.
validation.mtp: Full ten-prompt/four-category B1-B3 serial-exact safeguard passes all greedy and GPU/CPU acceptance checks and closes tracked allocations to zero.

decision: Retain the model/shape/row-qualified pair-owned Q4 source-F16 producer as the default. It improves every binding full-engine A/B cell with unchanged arithmetic and memory; keep the scalar registered fallback for policy misses, decode/MTP, peers, and bisection. Publish the fresh selector-unset XTX/W7900 rows and re-profile the retained M512 package before choosing another prefill lane.
